region: Hammondsport · Keuka Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Living Roots Wine & Co. was founded in 2016 by Sebastian and Colleen Hardy, and makes wine in two hemispheres. Seb is a sixth-generation South Australian winemaker; Colleen, from the Rochester area, met him while working a vintage there. They opened Rochester’s only urban winery in 2017 and later built a winery and tasting room on Colleen’s family’s Shale Creek Vineyard above Keuka Lake. Their Finger Lakes range focuses on whites and sparkling wines, with a few cool-climate reds, and in 2023 Halliday’s Wine Companion named Living Roots Australia’s Best New Winery.

Cabernet Franc has become the Finger Lakes’ signature red: it ripens more reliably than Cabernet Sauvignon in a short season and gives fragrant, medium-bodied wines with red fruit and a peppery edge. Living Roots aims for freshness rather than weight. Its recent Cabernet Francs have been fermented with a high share of whole berries, which keeps the fruit bright, while tannin and spice are drawn out slowly as the berries break down; the wine is wild fermented and bottled unfined and unfiltered. Expect bright red fruit: cranberry and tart cherry, with a subtle peppery spice and lively acidity. Decanter reviewed this 2023 vintage in early 2026.
facts: Wild ferment, high proportion of whole berries (producer’s 2021 method)
